system.description:
All food within near of you is blessed by @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.patrons-and-deities.Item.FhDBOHUircue27aV]{Gede}’s bounty.

Creatures who willingly join you in eating the food who are not friendly toward you become so for one day. This effect ends if you do anything to harm them.

Creatures who are already friendly toward you regain [[/r 1d6]] HP and may make an additional check to end any poisons or diseases affecting them.

A being can only be affected by this spell once per day.

Uneaten food loses the effects of this spell after the meal is over.
